liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stander On The Mountain** (3 reviews): Reviewer says this show has the final performance of the song; Reviewer calls it the only stateside performance, a majestic song Jerry was just starting to master [12][18][22]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer found it heartfelt and emotional, fitting after the long absence and Brent's loss [16]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Singled out, along with Estimated Prophet, as outstanding and worth downloading for [14]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer calls the space segment amazing [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stander On The Mountain**: rare: 4 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-12-03.sbd.miller.81740.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 157 min; rated 3/5 by 8 [1]. Said about its sound: On the soundboard, Vince is a bit too high in the mix; Soundboard has Bruce and Vince prominent in the mix, leaving Jerry room for chords [18][20]
- **gd90-12-03.nak.wiley.13992.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 160 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [4]. Said about its sound: Very good audience recording; the grand piano effect from Hornsby backing the band sounds nice; Reviewer finds the recording quality great; Audience tape is quite good, given that the Coliseum is a hard room for tapers [12][14][15][17]
- **gd1990-12-03.154445.4mic.mix.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 158 min [5]
- **gd1990-12-03.138092.BK4011.Darroch.Ammons.fob.t-flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 162 min [8]

## Around the show

- Sikiru Adepoju joins the band for the drums segment [12]
- First chance for West Coast fans to see the new lineup; Shoreline shows were canceled after Brent's death [15]
- Weir says something about the Niners from the stage [20]
- Reviewer calls the performance weak, among the three worst of 1990, and recommends 12-4-1990 as far better [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-12-03.sbd.miller.81740.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell Metal Capsule/Dolby B) D [1]
- **gd90-12-03.nak.wiley.13992.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Unknown; transferred by Tim Wiley; source: Audience Recording [4]
- **gd1990-12-03.154445.4mic.mix.1gen.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Recorded by Charlie Miller  October 10, 2021; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: 2 x Nakamichi 100/CP4 + 2 x AKG C1000S (Cardioid) > Boss BX-4 > Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6C/Maxell Metal 100) > Cassette (Maxell XLII-S90) [5]. Also: Recorded front row center in the tapers' section; the uploader's masters were lost, so this derives from a friend's copy; Source is 153867, transferred at 24-bit/96k down to 16-bit/44.1k [5]
- **gd1990-12-03.138092.BK4011.Darroch.Ammons.fob.t-flac16**: taped by Rob Darroch; transferred by John Ammons and Joel Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Rob Darroch FOB DFC Recording: B&K 4011s at 110 degrees ORTF on Schoeps T-bar > Neumann Power Supply > Panasonic SV255; 1st set stand at 6'1",… [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Wolfgang's: [Grateful Dead Laminate from Oakland Coliseum Arena, Dec 3, 1990 at Wolfgang's](https://www.wolfgangs.com/backstage-passes/grateful-dead/laminate/OCA901203.html) [25]
